rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The first sentence retells Colossians 2:1 when it says Paul is struggling for people he has never met face to face, but the card cites only Colossians 2:2. Its citation should cover Colossians 2:1-2.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
